asset.name: Stepper
asset.description: The increment and decrement control combining buttons, direct entry, constraints, press-and-hold acceleration, formatted values, and animated numeric feedback.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, and radius resolve to declared ramps rather than literals.
Pointer, touch, keyboard, press, and focus-visible behavior is owned once rather than reimplemented.
Controlled and uncontrolled operation share one contract and one event shape.
Acceleration on hold shares the long-press cancellation semantics.

suggests.reason: Animated value transitions suit dashboards and are noise in dense data entry.
